ctx.x: So then Troy Floyd was pretty -- name band then, you know. It was a bigger name than the St. Louis Merrymakers. So a friend of Herschel's had been trying to get him in that band for a long, long time and the tenor player that was playing in the band was a tenor player by the name of Funny Bagsby and he quit the band, Funny Bagsby was his name. I never forget. So Herschel joined that band. They told him they'd let him play tenor and that's when he went to Troy Floyd to play tenor. And I later played with him, you…
And then all the time though, after Milton, I was listening to a tenor player, me and Herschel, also Milton, by the name of Prince Robinson. That's Harold Vick's uncle.
